title: Run state
description: State of one review run, kept in its work directory. The CLI moves it through resolved, collected, judged, finalized, planned and published.

forge.description: Platform of the whole cascade; a cascade uses one platform only.

root.description: Change request the review started from.

cascade.description: Cascade limits actually used in this run, set by the root change request's repository.

maxDepth.description: Deepest level of Related Changes that is reviewed; the root is level 0.

maxChangeRequests.description: Most change requests reviewed in one cascade, the root included, counted in discovery order.

changeRequests.description: The root and every Related Changes entry found from it, including the ones that are skipped, in discovery order. Related Changes lines that cannot be parsed are not listed here; they are reported in the summary and make the cascade INCOMPLETE.

items.description: One change request of the cascade.

depth.description: Level in the cascade; the root is 0.

parent.description: Change request whose Related Changes listed this one; absent for the root.

skipReason.description: Why a skipped entry is not reviewed: already-done is a ticked entry; over-depth-limit is deeper than cascade.maxDepth; over-count-limit comes after cascade.maxChangeRequests change requests, the root included, in discovery order. over-depth-limit, over-count-limit, other-platform and not-found make the cascade INCOMPLETE; already-done, cycle, self-reference and not-a-change-request do not.

title.description: Title on the platform, once known.

runId.description: Identifier of a review run, also the name of its work directory.

sha.description: Full commit SHA, 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

timestamp.description: UTC time in RFC 3339 format, for example 2026-11-02T10:15:00Z.
